quests.title: Remnants of the Shadow Realm

dialogue.t: This pedestal looks interesting... I'm curious to know what it's used for.
Well, for starters, I can definitely confirm that it's Shadow Realm technology.
Hey there. I'm Trapeznikov, a friend of Alyosha's.
Remember when I said I was gonna bring someone I know from the Rokot? This is the guy. He's a real expert on Shadow Realm tech.
So anyway, the pedestal. Any idea what it does?
Looks to me like some sort of device for browsing information. But you need the right access to unlock it...
Looks like we can use this pedestal to look up information on those technological creations.
This access card of yours is really quite something, {NICKNAME}. It activated this pedestal, opens barriers...
I expect we'll need to unlock the relevant clearance first, though. I bet it involves the symbols on the card in some way...

dialogue.sit: Can you teach me more about these technologies?
I want to learn how to use them.

dialogue.t: You want me to... teach you? I'm afraid my knowledge is rudimentary at best... But I'll do my best to answer any questions you have.

quests.description: You recall the pedestal that you and Alyosha found earlier. It seems to have something to do with the Shadow Realm…
